pageTitle: Vandashi — a video studio built around your creative direction
pageDescription: Create videos with Codex and Hyperframes. Keep your creative guides, scripts, assets, and version history on your computer. Free, open-source software.
heroTitle: Shape the video. Keep your direction.
heroBody: Write with Codex, preview your video, and refine it in Hyperframes Studio.
free: Free, open-source software. AI uses your own Codex account and its available allowance.
creationCaption: Your script and the editable video, side by side.
creationAlt: Vandashi’s Creation workspace with the script for The hidden city beside its dark green video preview and saved version history.
directionTitle: Give every video a starting point.
directionBody: Keep your preferences for scripts, titles, thumbnails, and editing in shared creative guides. Refine them as your channel finds its voice.
directionAlt: The Northstar Stories brand workspace: an editable long-form title guide beside its dedicated AI conversation.
assetsTitle: Build a library you can use again.
assetsBody: Keep media with a single video or share it across your brand. Preview, describe, and find the right asset without leaving your project.
assetsAlt: Vandashi’s shared asset library with a generated cinematic city thumbnail selected for preview and metadata inspection.
clipsTitle: One video. More ways to tell it.
clipsBody: Turn landscape videos into independently editable vertical or square clips. Each keeps its own script, packaging, and version history.
clipsAlt: The Clips workspace with the portrait excerpt A hidden city selected from the original landscape video.
ownershipBody: Brand guides, scripts, assets, and Git history live in folders on your computer. Open them, edit them, and take them with you.
privacy: AI requests go through Codex. Publishing uses the external services you choose.
setupBody: Ask your coding agent to install Vandashi, or follow the setup guide yourself.
copyFailed: Couldn’t copy. Select the prompt below and copy it manually.
promptLabel: Setup prompt for your coding agent
setupPrompt: Install and open Vandashi from https://github.com/igormidev/Vandashi. Inspect its README and AGENTS.md first. Use the latest repository state and Node.js 24. Set ONNXRUNTIME_NODE_INSTALL=skip in the installation environment, then run npm ci to use the included CPU inference runtime without downloading CUDA. Check Git and Codex CLI; install missing prerequisites from their official sources without replacing my existing configurations. Ask me to sign in directly if Codex needs authentication. Install the bundled Hyperframes skill with `node node_modules/hyperframes/bin/hyperframes.mjs skills update --json`, verify the media prerequisites, run the checks, then start `npm run dev` and open the desktop app. Keep my existing projects and credentials intact. Report any failed dependency check with the exact error.
requirements: Requires Node.js 24, Git, and a signed-in Codex CLI. Rendering also needs FFmpeg, FFprobe, and a supported Chrome runtime.
platforms: Built for macOS, Windows, and Linux.
